candidates.change_summary: Change the required ticket payment from TICKET_AMOUNT to TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 so play will revert unless different value is sent, altering pot updates when calls succeed.
Always treat the random outcome as 0 by replacing the computed random with constant 0 so the winner branch (which resets pot) always executes.
Never reset pot in the winning branch by removing the assignment pot = 0, so pot retains its value after a win.
Move the pot increment to after the random check so pot is only increased when the loser branch occurs, changing pot after play.
Increase the fee paid to bank from FEE_AMOUNT to FEE_AMOUNT + 1, altering the remaining pot value and thus its value observed after play.
Change require to allow any msg.value (remove exact equality), so pot can accumulate different amounts and play() observable pot differs.
Change random computation to use only block.timestamp, altering win probability and thus pot observable after play().
Change branch condition to random == 1 so different coin side wins and pot behavior is swapped.
Transfer fee to msg.sender instead of bank, changing final balances and pot behavior observable after play().
Omit resetting pot to zero after a win, so pot remains and observable play() state differs.
